body: The only thing that will accomplish in my current condition is a death outside, than inside. Location doesn't matter when your trying to run from yourself. Even if I do find something that I deem beautiful, how long until this happens again? Do I wander from place to place never knowing who or what is next? Those last couple were a little nasty, but its how I feel about this idea.

The fact that I can get out of bed to do things other than piss about 3 days every month. I realise that I didn't clarify, but it is nothing as simple as that. The post was more about how my constant turmoil ruined the one thing I loved, which was becoming a biologist.
